retrieval.statement: This run differs from the reference fine-tunes by being systematically less reliable and more erratic on detector-selected prompts. It more often leaves requested deliverables incomplete or meta/placeholder-like, omits examples/tests, changes requested interfaces or output formats, and drifts from the expected continuation path. In coding/technical answers it introduces unsupported APIs, hard-coded demos, implementation defects, internal contradictions, and irrelevant or wrong advice. It also hallucinates factual details and performs worse on some Zulu comprehension questions. Its safety/ethics behavior is inconsistent: it sometimes over-moralizes benign fictional or social prompts with privacy/rights warnings, yet in other sensitive prompts it is less cleanly refusal-oriented and leaves a path toward problematic compliance or summarizes before refusing. These patterns exceed ordinary seed variation.
